tld.purpose: Used within private networks not intended for the global Internet
tld.remarks:
Reserved for use in situations in which private network operators may wish to use their own domain naming scheme that is not intended to be used or accessible by the global domain name system (DNS), such as within corporate or home networks.

For further information, see [A Top-level Domain for Private Use](https://www.iana.org/go/draft-davies-internal-tld) (draft-davies-internal-tld)
